name: Cosmos QA: Contextual Commonsense Machine Reading Comprehension
description: Cosmos QA is a large-scale dataset of 35,600 multiple-choice questions designed to evaluate machine reading comprehension requiring contextual commonsense reasoning. Focusing on reading between the lines to predict everyday events and consequences across human narrative blogs.

publisher.name: University of Washington / Allen Institute for AI
